description: Independently verify a signed Solana Swap Guard settlement: structural shape, the Ed25519 attester signature, and attester trust against the published Insight public key. Returns valid/invalid with a machine-readable reason plus the signed decisionHash, transaction signature, status, and attester so a third party can detect two valid closures binding one decisionHash to different transactions. This checks the signature only; it does not re-read the chain.
name: verify_solana_swap_guard_settlement
